Railway RRC SR Apprentice Online Form 2026 (4471 Posts) - Complete Details

Short Information : Railway Recruitment Cell Southern Railway (RRC-SR) has released the notification for the post of various Trade Apprentice. This recruitment has been issued for 4471 posts. Online applying process for Railway RRC SR Apprentice Recruitment 2026 has started from 28 August 2026 & the candidates can apply till 27 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for Railway RRC SR Apprentice Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 28 August 2026
  • Last Date : 27 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 27 September 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST, PWD : 0/-
  • All Female Candidates : 0/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
